name: io.github.allooloo/rco-records
title: Allooloo Receipts
description: The record of what the agent relied on: a signed, chained receipt per cleared read. Verify by id.

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Check any receipt by its id: the hash, the signature and its place in the chain. Public, no key needed.

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: The audit trail of a firm's own AI agents: every cleared read, in order, under the firm's key.

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: A signed statement of a firm's receipts for a period, for books and records and for its auditor.

tools.name: issue_auditor_key
tools.description: A firm gives its auditor a key to read and verify the firm's receipts independently.

tools.name: write_receipt
tools.description: Called by Allooloo's own MCPs when a read is cleared. One receipt per cleared read.

subject.description: what was read: the identifier (an ISIN, LEI, GTIN, ticker, record id …)

subject_type.description: isin | lei | gtin | ticker | cmr | fo-record | … (open list)

market.description: ISO country or exchange code of the read

rule_version.description: the rule set and version the gate cleared under

cleared_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC; stored to the second; the door's clock when absent

answer_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the canonical answer bytes the agent received

caller.description: who asked, when the gate knows it: x402:<wallet address>; stored only as its sha256

caller_key.description: the customer key the reader presented to the gate (RCO-Key); the door checks it and stores sha256("key:" + key id) as caller
